styleLock.backgroundSystem: strict alternation between a deep black studio stage (#0B0B0E, with engraved concentric sound-ripple floor or fine dark particle spray) and a seamless pure white field (#FFFFFF, with a pale radially engraved disc or a striped spec table); no third background type, no scenic gradients except the flat accent-orange closing panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: hard rim light tracing the housing edges plus a soft specular top edge; deep falloff to black on dark panels, diffuse high-key on white panels; one physically grounded contact shadow whenever the product touches a surface; 5600K ambience on the single wearing scene
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte lacquered stage floor engraved with concentric ripple rings in #1B1D22 on dark panels; pale engraved radial disc in #E7E8EB on white panels; nothing glossy or mirrored
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; heavy condensed Chinese display headline with a short dash rule beneath it, uppercase letterspaced English kicker above it, small grey body lines in #8A8F98 on dark and #6B7076 on light; all rendered Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and kept to one headline plus two short lines per screen
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside plain circles, one colour per panel (#141417 on white, #F2F3F5 on black), no fill, no 3D, max four in a row
styleLock.presentationRules: the product is always the same object at the same scale; earpieces and cable hang in one loose self-supporting loop that reads as real weight; straight shafts, plugs and table rules stay perfectly straight; no on-screen UI, no added controls, one accent orange glint maximum per panel
noDrift: no invented logos, wordmarks or interface screens
no bent cable kinks, warped ellipses or curved straight edges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: premium club-stage electronics ecommerce visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of deep black #0B0B0E, pure white #FFFFFF, pale grey #F5F6F8 and one accent orange #E8540F; cool tone with a single warm accent; alternating black-stage and seamless-white backgrounds only; hard rim light plus soft specular top edge, deep falloff to black on dark panels, diffuse high-key on white panels, always one grounded contact shadow where the product rests; modern geometric sans-serif with a heavy condensed Chinese display headline, a short dash rule under it, an uppercase letterspaced English kicker and thin-line circular icons; structured infographic components of three-column spec blocks, a striped two-column spec table, numbered circles and a CTA pill button; the product is one identical object per panel at stable scale, straight edges kept straight, cable curves physically self-supported; Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 only where specified; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented logos or interface screens.

provenance.notes: 形态判定：非真无线、非头戴、非骨传导、非耳夹——为带耳翼的入耳式有线带线控耳机（画面可见直角圆形插头、在线线控模块、硅胶耳塞与耳翼），形态本身即与库内 shoujishuma-zhenwuxian-banruer-chongdiancang-erji（真无线半入耳+充电舱，曜黑展台）与 shoujishuma-senlv-banruer-yinfu-shengchang-erji（森绿半入耳，浅色植物系）区隔。视觉体系再以画面可见特征拉开：本套为「曜黑 #0B0B0E 与纯白 #FFFFFF 双场严格交替 + 整版亮橙 #E8540F 收口」的高对比俱乐部舞台系，核心母题是线材自支撑悬垂成环、同心声波刻纹地面、放射刻纹圆盘、零件一排竖列剖列与三栏/斑马纹参数版式；不含充电舱、不含植物道具、不含浅色暖调，与前两版的曜黑展台或浅绿植物系均不同。已剥离内容：品牌名与型号名、机身铭文、标语原句（含中英文）、全部芯片与规格数值（倍率、频响、续航、待机、频段、失真度等一律改为 {callout_*} 占位符）、末片的二维码与入会免费促销块（只保留无联系方式、无价格、无优惠承诺的 CTA 收口结构）、佩戴者面部身份（改为后侧 45 度过肩机位）。L1 判定为手机数码，与源夹数码类目一致，无冲突；L2 取耳机音频。
